sections.heading: Fixture profile default test fails downstream
sections.key: h1:fixture profile default test fails downstream

counterexample_or_failure_condition: the approval predates an affected repair or is not independently grounded
expected: the approving actor independently verifies the current affected scope
known_bad_detection_method: Simulated distribution profile via patch.object on container_fixture_profile.container_fixture_args; the current combined test failed under it and passed under the default profile.
limitations: Approval remains scoped to the recorded actor and affected review boundary.
observed: Readiness review of the plan against the current tree. Probe: with container_fixture_profile.container_fixture_args patched to a distribution-style profile ({'feature':'fixture','kind':'enh'} / {'scope':'set'}), the current combined test_default_profile_adds_nothing fails with {'feature': 'fixture', 'kind': 'enh'} != {}; under the default profile it passes. AC-1 is therefore falsifiable on the current code. The helpers resolve the profile at call time (server_tools_support._container_fixture_call imports the module inside the call), so a nested in-test patch overrides an outer simulated profile, and a pass-through test that patches the wrong object fails AC-1's simulated run. Advisories, non-blocking: (1) default_profile_only keys on the loaded vocabulary/record constants, not on the fixture profile, so a distribution that fills the fixture profile but keeps the default vocabulary still fails the shipped-default test; the Risks row records this and the reporting distribution renames, so Product Intent is met for renaming distributions only. (2) AC-1 does not by itself catch a pass-through test that asserts nothing about the arguments; the implementer should keep the exact self.calls equality and show it fails when a helper drops or alters an argument.
proposition: qa-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

known_bad_detection_method: In-process replacement of container_fixture_args with Waveforge's failing profile value; the current combined test failed, confirming the plan's premise and AC-1 known-bad.
limitations: Approval remains scoped to the recorded actor and affected review boundary.
observed: Plan matches code. _container_fixture_call in tests/server_tools_support.py imports container_fixture_profile at call time and reads container_fixture_profile.container_fixture_args, the same module object the test imports, so patch.object(container_fixture_profile, 'container_fixture_args', ...) isolates the pass-through test (the existing test_profile_arguments_reach_the_served_tool already uses this pattern). default_profile_only keys on SHIPPED_DEFAULTS (vocabulary_profile, record_paths constants), so it runs upstream (profile_differences() == []) and skips under a renamed profile like Waveforge's; it does not key on container_fixture_profile, which the plan's Risks row acknowledges. Known-bad reproduced: with container_fixture_args replaced by a profile returning {'feature':'fixture','kind':'enh'}, the current test_default_profile_adds_nothing fails. Implementer notes: patch the module attribute, not server_tools_support (it has no such attribute); the patched callable must accept (tool_name, root).
proposition: code-reviewer approves the current affected scope
safety_and_authorization: Local review evidence only; no external side effects.

observed: Prepare-phase Wave Council PASS (moderator: council-chair; primer-depth: standard; seats: red-team, architecture-reviewer; rotating-seat: architecture-reviewer; strongest-challenge: default_profile_only keys on the vocabulary/record-path constants, not on container_fixture_profile, so a distribution that keeps the default vocabulary but fills the fixture profile still fails the new shipped-default test; accepted in the Risks row as non-blocking because such a distribution renamed nothing and Waveforge renames and skips; strongest-alternative: key the shipped-default check on the fixture profile module itself (for example a frozen pin of its source) instead of the vocabulary marker, rejected as a new mechanism for a hypothetical distribution). Architecture seat: the split keeps the boundary clean, since only the fork-editable module varies by distribution and the upstream-owned test now patches it locally for the pass-through check; the shipped-default check belongs beside the helper tests as the profile's own contract test. Known-bad reproduced read-only: the current combined test passes under the default profile and fails with the profile patched to {'feature': 'fixture', 'kind': 'enh'}. code-reviewer and qa-reviewer readiness approvals current, 0 findings, lint passed.

known_bad_detection_method: Scratch-copy mutants: Waveforge-style profile args, dropped helper kwargs/slug, removed patch.object, renamed COUNCIL_DISPLAY_NAME for the skip marker; each produced the expected pass/fail/skip.
limitations: Approval remains scoped to the recorded actor and affected review boundary.
observed: In a scratch copy of .wavefoundry/framework/scripts (python3 -B, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1): baseline both new tests pass and the module's 8 tests are OK. M1 distribution profile (container_fixture_args returns {'feature':'fixture','kind':'enh'}): pass-through test passes, test_shipped_profile_adds_nothing FAILS ({'feature': 'fixture', 'kind': 'enh'} != {}); HEAD's test_default_profile_adds_nothing also FAILS under it, reproducing the downstream report. M2a close_container drops **kwargs and M2b create_container drops slug: pass-through test FAILS with a calls-list mismatch each time. M3 pass-through test with patch.object removed, under the distribution profile: it FAILS (profile args leak into calls). M4 marker: with vocabulary_profile.COUNCIL_DISPLAY_NAME renamed plus the distribution profile, test_shipped_profile_adds_nothing is skipped by default_profile_only and the module reports OK (skipped=1). All mutants restored; no __pycache__ under .wavefoundry/framework.

known_bad_detection_method: QA scratch-tree mutants: distribution-style profile (pass-through passes, shipped-default fails), argument-dropping helper and removed patch (pass-through fails), renamed vocabulary (shipped-default skips); HEAD combined test fails under a distribution profile
limitations: Approval remains scoped to the recorded actor and affected review boundary.
observed: Delivery Wave Council (moderator: council-chair; seats: red-team, architecture-reviewer; lanes: code-reviewer, qa-reviewer). Read the change doc, wave Objective, the test diff and the 22sft CHANGELOG bullet; ledger shows code-reviewer and qa-reviewer delivery approvals current with 0 findings. The diff splits test_default_profile_adds_nothing into test_an_empty_profile_passes_the_test_arguments_through_unchanged (patch.object replaces container_fixture_profile.container_fixture_args with an empty profile, exact self.calls equality kept) and test_shipped_profile_adds_nothing marked @default_profile_only; record_layout_support.default_profile_only skips when loaded constants differ from the shipped defaults. Red-team: the skip keys on the renamed vocabulary, not on the fixture profile content, so a distribution that keeps the default vocabulary and fills in the profile still fails the shipped-default test; this residual is the readiness-accepted risk in the change doc. Architecture: test-only, no boundary or shipped-behavior change; CHANGELOG bullet matches. QA mutants (relied on): distribution profile -> pass-through passes, shipped-default fails; helper dropping an argument and removing the patch each fail the pass-through test; renamed vocabulary skips the shipped-default test. Coordinator full suite 12,591 tests / 231 files / 12 skips green. Intent: partially -- Waveforge (renamed) runs the helper tests unchanged and upstream still proves its default, but the Objective's 'a distribution that fills in the profile' is not met for a default-vocabulary distribution.
